items.title: Live: US delegation led by Vance due to land in Pakistan for Iran peace talks
items.description: Iranian officials accuse the US of "aggressive acts" and violating the ceasefire, saying there are no plans to attend peace talks being organised in Pakistan next week. Follow live.

items.title: Tsunami warning as magnitude-7.7 earthquake hits north-east Japan
items.description: An earthquake strikes off the island of Honshu, triggering tsunami warnings and widespread evacuation orders, affecting around 170,000 people.

items.title: Fair Work Commission makes 'historic' fuel order for truck drivers
items.description: The Fair Work Commission orders that retailers, miners and other companies that use truck drivers and transport operators must hold twice-monthly reviews of fuel prices and adjust their rates accordingly.

items.title: EV drivers are being left waiting with just 45 chargers per car in Australia
items.description: With no end in sight to soaring fuel prices, 7.30 decided to take an EV for a test drive to see how far it could take our reporter, and if Australia's EV charging network stacks up.

items.title: 'Book early': Australians reconsider holiday and work travel plans
items.description: The war in the Middle East has caused chaos across some of the world's busiest aviation regions, with many Australians now reconsidering their travel plans — or abandoning them altogether.

items.title: Prospector finds 800,000 year old australite
items.description: The object formed when a meteorite slammed into Earth more than 800,000 years ago.

items.title: Think you have ADHD? Here's what getting assessed looks like
items.description: Who can diagnose ADHD, what a proper assessment should include, and the red flags to look out for.

items.title: Former footballer Barry Cable found not guilty of sexually abusing child
items.description: Former Australian Rules footballer Barry Cable has been found not guilty of sexually abusing a child in Perth in the 1960s.

items.title: Rebel Wilson accused of defaming actor with sexual harassment claim
items.description: Hollywood star Rebel Wilson is being sued in the Federal Court for defamation by one of the lead actor's in her directorial debut film, The Deb.

items.title: PM won't criticise Trump for 'lying' about Australia
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is pressed on his relationship with the United States and President Donald Trump on 7.30. Here's what he told Sarah Ferguson.

items.title: Inquest hears of mother's final moments before death in Darwin safe house
items.description: An inquest has heard harrowing details of the final moments of a 33-year-old mother who bled to death after harming herself inside a Darwin domestic violence shelter.

items.title: Chinese robot beats human half-marathon world record
items.description: The winner from a Chinese smartphone maker reportedly completed the 21-kilometre race in 50 minutes and 26 seconds.

items.title: Qld minister says he never broke law amid questions on voting registration
items.description: Queensland's Olympics Minister Tim Mander has insisted he always complied with the state's electoral rules after he enrolled to vote at the address of a staff member.

items.title: AFL apologises after Butters appeal upheld, umpire abuse conviction quashed
items.description: The AFL appeals board has quashed Zak Butters's conviction for abusive language against umpire Nick Foot, saying a Tribunal member listening in while driving his car for part of the original hearing constitutes a miscarriage of justice.

items.title: Tempted to order in? Try these quick recipes instead
items.description: From frittata to one-pot pasta, these speedy dinners are perfect for busy evenings and worth adding to your regular rotation.

items.title: Quiz: Can you tame our tricky history questions?
items.description: Is two-up actually illegal in Australia? And what movie beat Crocodile Dundee to the top of the box office in 1986?

items.title: 'I had no-one to talk to': The 92yo trying to save his dying language
items.description: Peter is the last living speaker of the First Nations language Thiinma. When he met linguist Rosie, they used music to help keep his knowledge alive, and formed a beautiful friendship along the way.

items.title: Driver stood down after schoolboy dragged by bus
items.description: Authorities are investigating how a 12-year-old became trapped in a bus door before being dragged hundreds of metres down a suburban street in Melbourne.

items.title: Blues confirm Hollands has been admitted to hospital after concerning scenes
items.description: Carlton says young star Elijah Hollands has been admitted to hospital after suffering a mental health episode in Thursday night's match.

items.title: Childcare worker pleads not guilty to rape, indecent treatment
items.description: Childcare worker Joshua James Capps has pleaded not guilty to three counts of indecent treatment of a child in his care, and one count of rape.

items.title: Fishers make 'surprising' discovery of artificial leg on the beach
items.description: The prosthetic leg has been handed to police after being discovered by a couple while they were fishing on a NSW Mid North Coast beach.

items.title: Shane Flanagan's sacking is the same old story for St George Illawarra
items.description: St George Illawarra might have sacked coach Shane Flanagan amid a record losing streak, but such struggles have become sadly familiar to the joint venture.

items.title: 'Hard to break the habit': Why free public transport isn't enough to shift from cars
items.description: Free public transport is a popular policy, but researchers say it's not enough to convince drivers to leave the car at home.

items.title: Australia faced the same dilemma as China in 2004 but made the wrong call
items.description: While the rest of us count the cost in higher fuel costs, higher inflation and a weaker economy,  China — the actual winner of the war — will be enjoying a surge of global interest in its solar panels, wind turbines and electric vehicles.

items.title: Teen accused of toilet block assault took 'calculated steps', court hears
items.description: Prosecutors say the allegations against a teenage boy accused of sexually assaulting a child in a toilet block are so serious he should face trial in an adult court.
